positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: DAY TWENTY-TWO. ROTATE BTC -> ETH. Glamsterdam activates on the Sepolia testnet today (~13:53 UTC), inside this 24h window. It is the first public rehearsal of Ethereum's Q4 scaling upgrade (block-level access lists for parallel execution, plus ePBS). A clean activation removes the 'slipped again' overhang and keeps the Q4 mainnet timeline credible. Meanwhile BTC spot ETFs posted their first October outflow (-$89.9M on Oct 5), which takes away BTC's flow tailwind. The tape is quiet and slightly green (total cap ~$3.01T, +0.8% 24h), so it is a low-edge day and the rule keeps the book in a major. Board (Robinhood mark vs CT-midnight open): ADA +2.56%, LINK +1.55%, LTC +1.18%, BTC +0.70%, XRP +0.69%, DOGE +0.67%, AVAX +0.56%, ETH +0.54%, SOL +0.27%.
positions.driver:

BOUGHT ETH at 2,714.55 (same call/asOf). 4.992393 ETH = $13,552.10 deployed, 100%. Stop 2,497.39 (-8%, majors tier).

WHY BTC WENT: it failed both legs of its hold test. It ranked #4 of 9 (+0.70%), not top-three, and it is at 86.2K, not above 87,500. ETF flows also flipped to outflow.

RUNNERS-UP: ADA (#1 for the second straight day) is still stalling at 0.28 resistance with no named catalyst and would need a 12% alt stop. LINK (#2, about 30% off its September lows, CCIP 2.0) needs to reclaim 14.30 trend resistance first, and an alt stop doubles the downside on a low-edge day. LTC has no catalyst.

CROSS-CHECK: Robinhood ETH mark 2,716.21 vs canonical 2,714.55 (~6bp). Search used for narrative only.
positions.risks:
Binary event risk: developers flagged critical bugs and fake-builder attack vectors around the Sepolia fork. A messy activation or a new mainnet delay could knock ETH below 2,650. Classic sell-the-news is also possible. ETH is weak on relative strength (#8 of 9), so this is a catalyst bet, not a momentum one.

FRICTION: Robinhood spread ~185bp round-trip on ETH; the paper book does not charge it.

TEST FOR TOMORROW: hold ETH only if it is TOP-THREE on the nine-name board OR closes above 2,780 (post-fork breakout). STRUCTURAL INVALIDATION: loses 2,650. Hard stop 2,497.39 (-8%).
